instruction:
Parse the hierarchy of `C:\Users\user\Desktop\FULLADD.DSN` and write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\hierarchy.json`. Use OrCAD's native Capture design converter `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\cap2xml.exe`. For this task, use `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe` for OrCAD schematics and `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\allegro.exe` for board work.

JSON format: - Top-level field `root`: the name of the root schematic. - Top-level field `schematics`: a dictionary keyed by schematic name. - Each schematic entry must contain: - `page_count`: number of pages inside that schematic. - `total_parts`: total number of part instances across all pages in that schematic. - `referenced_hier_blocks`: a list of schematic names referenced by hierarchical blocks from that schematic. Repeated references must be listed repeatedly, and order is arbitrary.
